interior_bytes_per_RU.includes: outgoing interface words of every request-local relation VU at actual widths (S.out of the unit)
interior_bytes_per_RU.excludes: shared weight input gates (referenced, not recommitted); the request's prompt-token and seed input gates and its served output tokens (committed at serve time)
interior_bytes_per_RU.note: served output tokens are produced by request-local VUs and so are inside `bits`; they are < 1e-6 of it and are not subtracted

widths.method: veritor.plans.boundary.hierarchical_boundary(unit).outputs: gates of the unit consumed outside it (or protected), at wire width; out_scalars = len(S.out), out_bits = sum of widths
widths.notes: widths verified on 135121435 of 233879732 units (kinds with < 10k units: every unit; larger kinds: ~3000 evenly spaced units per kind incl. the first/last unit of the sampled runs; within a sampled run every unit is attributed a width -- constant between equal samples, change points located by bisection; kinds where not every run was sampled: per-width counts are SCALED ESTIMATES from the sampled runs, the kind total is exact; per-kind basis in kinds_raw.width_basis); NOT constant within 6 kinds, each split into one family per width: ['ArgmaxStep_v1|scan', 'Const16[0x0000]_v1|primitive', 'Const32[0x00000000]_v1|primitive', 'F32Add_v1|primitive', 'GemmCoordinate_v1{K=1536}|batch', 'Input|batch|weights']

provenance.kappa: S.out width of the unit (a valid cut, conservative); the kind-table narrowing min(out_bits, reach_bits, ancestor_bits) is not computed for this horizon
provenance.notes_shared_inputs: Input[weights] is the canonical global set of shared weight-input VUs (scope: global, counted once); Input[prompt] is request-local. The program has no seed input gate (greedy decoding: token selection is deterministic).
